messages.text: The north quarry closed at 20:00 UTC.
The north quarry gate is still admitting carts.
The closure notice is posted at the office.
Two loaded carts entered after 20:00 UTC.

main_story.headline: Gate Security and Closure Protocol at the North Quarry
main_story.lede: A discussion emerged regarding the discrepancy between administrative notices and physical gate security at a local extraction site.
main_story.body:
The operational status of the *north quarry* was discussed following reports of inconsistent gate behavior. **Uma** confirmed that the facility is scheduled to close at 20:00 UTC, noting that an official notice remains posted at the office to communicate this schedule to all personnel.

Despite these measures, **Vik** reported that the gate continues to admit carts regardless of the clock. Specifically, **Vik** noted that two loaded units successfully entered the facility after the 20:00 UTC deadline had passed.
